title: Bold pagos en linea WordPress plugin before 3.5.1 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability in the…
description: The Bold pagos en linea WordPress plugin versions before 3.5.1 has an improper signature verification vulnerability in its bold_co webhook. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to forge payment notifications by exploiting the handling of the metadata.reference field and an empty test_secret_key HMAC. As a result, attackers can mark any unpaid WooCommerce order as paid without authorization.
